forum.title: Error installing C5xx HAL drivers pack: "Unable to get local issuer certificate"
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Srikar and Welcome to ST Community!

In this case, what you need is to configure a proxy or a certificate to be able to access the servers and download packages.

* Get your certificate from your company IT or company portal.

* Place it under C:\certificate, for example.

* Add the Windows environment variable **NODE\_EXTRA\_CA\_CERTS** with the path to this certificate file. (Make sure that the path has no quotes.)

![Oussama_TROUDI_0-1777453770153.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ae6a955a-09c1-ab69-af67-7c3e63fb322d.png "Oussama_TROUDI_0-1777453770153.png")

* Finally, restart STM32CubeMX2.

You can also refer to this article for more details on: [How to configure the proxy or certificate](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/how-to-configure-the-proxy-or-certificate-for-stm32cubeide-for/ta-p/846476 "How to configure the proxy or certificate")
